profile_selection.source: immutable 72-action catalog fields, not action IDs

measurement_only_changes: actual SFD1 v2 frame-context encode timing
complete SFD1 v2 and UDP byte accounting

accepted_historical_to_current_transitio.reason: opt-in receive diagnostics expose already-decoded intermediates; the default receive path and AE reconstruction arithmetic are unchanged
same-q evaluation-gate implementation was relocated and re-exported; this holdout-selection runner is not imported for Phase 11B execution
same-q evaluation-gate utility was added to shared provenance code; no AE model-forward arithmetic or checkpoint tensor interpretation changed

phase11b_device_repair_source_transition.reason: the receiver now supplies an explicit torch.device for noAE C2 tail placement; packet bytes, quantization and AE mathematics are unchanged

allocation.rule: floor(300*n_i/N), then largest fractional remainders; exact ties by ascending canonical episode_id

schedule_manifest.profile_order_basis: catalog fields: family registry order, quantizer registry order, q_e4=(0,3000,5000)

component_definitions.ae_decode_gpu_ms: CUDA-event selected AE decode duration; exact zero for noAE
component_definitions.ae_encode_gpu_ms: CUDA-event selected AE encode duration; exact zero for noAE
component_definitions.camera_pose_reconstruct_ms: host camera-world reconstruction from transmitted ego pose and the preloaded mount
component_definitions.capture_partition_edge_call_ms: exclusive host interval from edge call start through serialized result return
component_definitions.capture_partition_reassembly_to_edge_cal: exclusive host interval from receiver reassembly completion through queue handoff to edge call start
component_definitions.capture_partition_ue_call_ms: exclusive host interval from capture start through UE prepare return
component_definitions.capture_partition_ue_to_first_send_ms: exclusive host interval from UE return through fragment creation to immediately before first send
component_definitions.capture_to_edge_result_ms: host start immediately before UE front path through serialized edge return
component_definitions.envelope_context_validate_ms: combined SFD1 v2 context/session/catalog validation prefix before zstd-decompression boundary
component_definitions.frame_context_encode_ms: host construction of FrameContext plus actual SFD1 v2 envelope encoding
component_definitions.localhost_delivery_ms: immediately before first send through receiver reassembly completion
component_definitions.ranker_gpu_ms: CUDA-event ranker score_cells duration; exact zero for q=0 bypass
component_definitions.sfd1_fragment_send_ms: host chunk construction through last UDP send completion
component_definitions.tail_gpu_ms: combined frozen tail, camera postprocess and p025 CUDA-event duration
component_definitions.ue_prepare_ms: host boundary from context construction start through UE prepare return
component_definitions.zstd_compress_ms: existing UE mandatory-zstd compression host boundary

timing.gpu_event_synchronization: finish event synchronized for every GPU stage

mutual_exclusion.other_component_fields: diagnostic boundaries not added to the exclusive partition
mutual_exclusion.overlap: localhost_delivery_ms begins before UDP sending completes and therefore overlaps the send portion of sfd1_fragment_send_ms

timing.quantile_convention: nearest-rank: sorted_values[ceil(p*n)-1] for p=0.50 and p=0.95
